meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后多出三个子代理:查代码位置的 cavecrew-investigator、改 1-2 个文件的 cavecrew-builder、审 diff 的 cavecrew-reviewer。它们返回的工具结果被压缩,所以每次委派后主上下文占用更少。
howto.when: 需要定位代码、做小范围编辑或审 diff 时,按对照表挑对应子代理;若想要架构建议或成段文字,则用原生的 Explore、Code Reviewer。

say.text: 用 cavecrew-investigator 找一下 Y 在哪里被调用
say.note: 返回 path:line 列表,可直接 grep

say.text: 把 src/a.ts:42 这处改动交给 cavecrew-builder
say.note: 只适用于 1-2 个文件的明确改动

say.text: 用 cavecrew-reviewer 审一下当前 diff
say.note: 按文件、行号列出问题,不给架构意见

howto.what_en: Installs three subagent presets: cavecrew-investigator (locates code), cavecrew-builder (edits 1-2 files), cavecrew-reviewer (reviews a diff). Their tool results return compressed, so main context shrinks per delegation.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to locate code, make a surgical edit of 1-2 files, or review a diff. For architecture commentary or prose, use vanilla Explore or Code Reviewer instead.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-investigator to find where Y is called.
Have cavecrew-reviewer audit the current diff.
say_en.note: Lists issues by file and line
